ANCIENTSAWAKENED-INFO.title: Ancient Disabler Configs
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-INFO.description:
Ancient disabling and enabling configs have been moved to our other mod, Ancient Configs Plus.
If you want to disable or weight any ancients, vanilla or modded, go check it out!
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MITHRIX.title: Mithrix Relic Configs
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MULTIPLAYER_FLAWLESS_HA:
Enables a unique version of Flawless Hammer for multiplayer with +1 cost, but giving an extra turn to ALL allies.
(Disabling uses the singleplayer version in Multiplayer instead.)
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MULTIPLAYER_MONSOON_CHA: Disabled on default due to griefing potential.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SEBASTIAN.title: Sebastian Relic Configs
Causes Sebastian's Scanner to give relics to all players in multiplayer, regardless of if they have the relic or not.
